facts: Player controls one creature; other species members act independently.
Social and combat modes expose different ability sets.
Death returns the player to the home nest.
Intelligence progression adds pack slots, up to three companions.
Social challenges require matching the opponent action at equal or greater ability level.
Already impressed individuals cannot initiate another social challenge.
Friendly or Allied relations permit healing at their nests; Allied creatures can join a pack with available slots.
Defeating an individual worsens relations with its species.
Creator changes apply to the player species; nest migration is described.
